paper.title: Learning Neural Contextual Bandits Through Perturbed Rewards

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual bandit with finite K arms and neural (NTK) reward mapping
unmapped: each of the K arms has a fixed d-dimensional context vector x_i with ||x_i||_2=1; unknown reward mapping h(x) in [0,1] approximated by a wide ReLU network (NTK regime)
NTK matrix H on the context set satisfies H >= lambda_0 I
the learner's perturbation scale uses alpha_t, which depends on R, S, delta and lambda_K(A_K)
settings.definition_quote: We study the problem of contextual bandit with finite $K$ arms, where each arm is associated with a $d$-dimensional context vector: $\xb_i \in \RR^d$ for $i \in [K]$. ... $r_{a_t, t} = h(\xb_{a_t}) + \eta_{t}$. In particular, $h(\xb)$ ... satisfying $0 \leq h(\xb) \leq 1$ ... and $\eta_{t}$ is an $R$-sub-Gaussian random variable ... The goal is to minimize pseudo regret over $T$ rounds

bound.expression: 44*E*sqrt(pi)*(1 + sqrt((4*log(T) + 2*log(K))/(1 - lam/lambda_KA)))*(sigma*sqrt(d_eff*log(1 + T*K/lam) + 2 - 2*log(delta)) + sqrt(lam)*S)*sqrt(2*d_eff*T*log(1 + T*K/lam) + 2) + 7 + K
bound.expression_latex: R_T \leq \Gamma \Big(R\sqrt{\tilde{d}\log(1 + TK/\lambda) +2 - 2\log \delta} + \sqrt{\lambda}S\Big)\cdot\sqrt{2\tilde dT\log(1+TK/\lambda) +2} + 7 + K, \Gamma = 44\eb \sqrt{\pi} (1 + \sqrt{(4\log T + 2\log K) / (1 - \lambda \lambda_K^{-1}(\Ab_K))})

symbols.lambda_KA: K-th largest eigenvalue of the covariance matrix A_K after the initial K pulls

tuning: eta = C_1 (m T L + m lambda)^{-1}
J gradient-descent steps chosen as in proof

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Let $\tilde d$ be the effective dimension of the NTK kernel matrix $\Hb$. There exist positive constants $C_1$ and $C_r$, such that for any $\delta \in(0, 1)$, when network structure and the step size for model update satisfy $m \geq \text{poly}(T, L, K, \lambda^{-1}, S^{-1}, \log(1/\delta))$, $\eta = C_1( mTL +  m \lambda)^{-1}$ and $\lambda \geq \max\{1, S^{-2}\}$, with probability at least $1-\delta$, the cumulative regret of \model{} satisfies R_T \leq \Gamma(...)\cdot\sqrt{2\tilde dT\log(1+TK/\lambda) +2} + 7 + K

results.notes: Paper's R (sub-Gaussian parameter) mapped to sigma; paper's sigma is the perturbation scale (tuning). tilde d (NTK effective dimension, log det(I+TH/lambda)/log(1+TK/lambda)) mapped to d_eff. R_T is pseudo-regret holding with prob 1-delta over network initialization/observation noise. Abstract summarizes this as O_tilde(d_eff sqrt(T)). Context modelled as a fixed set of arm feature vectors (analysis uses NTK on fixed set {x_i}).
